Commons API response and unmodified 960×563 thumbnail captured by the image-helper
worker on 2026-11-13, before the model-call pause. No new network fetch is needed.

Photo: David Iliff (Diliff), [Colosseum in Rome, Italy — April 2007](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Colosseum_in_Rome,_Italy_-_April_2007.jpg),

The JSON preserves Commons' author and licence metadata for all search results.
Only this first result's actual image bytes are recorded. Tests that need several
candidates reuse those bytes to exercise the decision sequence, not visual quality.
Review replies in tests are scripted fixtures, never claimed as model judgements.
